name: MU_Maxient_Student_Roster
description:
Extracts all currently-enrolled Methodist University students from the Colleague ODS and pushes a date-stamped CSV to the Maxient SFTP import folder. The target term is supplied as a pipeline parameter (e.g. 2026FA, 2027SP) — this allows the roster to be pushed before a term's start date, which is required when onboarding a new term in Maxient ahead of move-in. Runs on a scheduled cadence — daily or weekly recommended.

Columns emitted (must match Maxient Person Field names in Admin > Import Settings):
  person_id, first_name, last_name, middle_name, preferred_name, email,
  date_of_birth, gender, classification, major, enrollment_type,
  campus, residence_hall, room_number

Advisor fields (advisor_name, advisor_email) are not included by default.
Add a LEFT JOIN on dbo.ods_student_advisors once the column names are
confirmed against your ODS: the advisor CTE pattern from the Carnegie
pipeline can be reused.

Field verification checklist before go-live:
  [ ] preferred_name      — confirm column exists in ods_person
  [ ] Maxient SFTP path   — confirm with your Maxient Customer Success contact

parameters.name: targetTerm
parameters.label: Target Term
parameters.description: The Colleague term ID to extract enrollment for (e.g. 2026FA, 2027SP). Must match a value in dbo.ods_terms.terms_id. Update this each semester before the scheduled run starts. Summer terms (SU) are not populated in ods_student_terms at Methodist and should not be used.

parameters.name: maxientSftpKey
parameters.label: Maxient SFTP Private Key
parameters.description: RSA private key in PEM format for Maxient SFTP authentication. MUST start with -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- (not BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY). To convert an existing OpenSSH key: ssh-keygen -p -m PEM -f your_key_file. To generate a new one: ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 2048 -m PEM -f maxient_key. Send the corresponding public key to Maxient support for registration.

parameters.name: maxientSftpUsername
parameters.label: Maxient SFTP Username
parameters.description: SFTP username provided by Maxient. Typically your institution's short name or a Maxient-assigned account ID.

parameters.name: maxientSftpHost
parameters.label: Maxient SFTP Host
parameters.description: Maxient SFTP hostname. Provided by your Maxient Customer Success contact (e.g. sftp.maxient.com or a dedicated subdomain).

parameters.name: maxientSftpPath
parameters.label: Maxient SFTP Import Path
parameters.description: Remote directory Maxient polls for incoming student roster files. Confirm with Maxient — common values: /import/, /students/, /roster/.

parameters.name: includeHeaders
parameters.description: Maxient requires a header row whose column names match the Person Field names configured in Maxient Admin > Import Settings. Must be true.

parameters.name: quoteStrings
parameters.description: Double-quote all fields to safely handle commas and special characters in names and program descriptions.

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.description: Maxient accepts CSV (comma) by default. Change only if your Maxient import profile is configured for a different delimiter.

config.selectQuery:
WITH

enrolled AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (sttr_student)
        sttr_student       AS person_id,
        sttr_student_load
    FROM   dbo.ods_student_terms
    WHERE  sttr_term            = '{{targetTerm}}'
      AND  sttr_current_status <> 'X'
    ORDER BY sttr_student
),

program AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (stpr_student)
        stpr_student      AS person_id,
        stpr_acad_program AS major
    FROM   dbo.ods_student_programs
    WHERE  stpr_current_status <> 'X'
    ORDER BY stpr_student, stpr_acad_program
),

housing AS (
    SELECT
        rmas_person_id  AS person_id,
        rmas_bldg       AS residence_hall,
        rmas_room       AS room_number
    FROM   dbo.ods_room_assignments
    WHERE  rmas_term = '{{targetTerm}}'
)

SELECT
    e.person_id,
    TRIM(p.first_name)                                        AS first_name,
    TRIM(p.last_name)                                         AS last_name,
    COALESCE(TRIM(p.middle_name), '')                         AS middle_name,
    COALESCE(TRIM(p.preferred_name), '')                      AS preferred_name,
    COALESCE(p.preferred_email_address, '')                   AS email,
    COALESCE(TO_CHAR(p.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '')         AS date_of_birth,
    CASE p.gender
        WHEN 'M' THEN 'Male'
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'Female'
        ELSE ''
    END                                                       AS gender,
    ''                                                        AS classification,
    COALESCE(TRIM(pr.major), '')                              AS major,
    CASE TRIM(e.sttr_student_load)
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'Full-Time'
        WHEN 'P' THEN 'Part-Time'
        ELSE COALESCE(TRIM(e.sttr_student_load), '')
    END                                                       AS enrollment_type,
    COALESCE(TRIM(s.stu_current_home_location), '')           AS campus,
    COALESCE(TRIM(h.residence_hall), '')                      AS residence_hall,
    COALESCE(TRIM(h.room_number), '')                         AS room_number
FROM   enrolled e
JOIN   dbo.ods_person p
         ON p.id          = e.person_id
JOIN   dbo.ods_students s
         ON s.students_id = e.person_id
LEFT JOIN program pr
         ON pr.person_id  = e.person_id
LEFT JOIN housing h
         ON h.person_id   = e.person_id
ORDER BY e.person_id
